convention: Agent Friendly Web project readiness manifest; not an official standard
human_route_strategy: Spanish unprefixed canonical; English under /en; Portuguese under /pt; canonical and hreflang equivalents

infrastructure.note: Hosting migration state is published separately so active, transitional, candidate and retired surfaces are never conflated.

external_verification.note: Cloudflare post-release observation reached Level 4 Agent-Integrated. Third-party observations remain separate from AF-0 to AF-5.

infrastructure_status.note: Dated project ledger for the canonical origin, transitional runtime, Cloudflare-native candidate, retired surfaces and next gate.

evidence_comparison.note: Client-side comparison only; public inputs are not persisted observations.

intake_assistant.note: Deterministic and client-side. No autonomous save, email, voice, payment or website mutation.

public_guide.note: Deterministic public guidance with cited sources and immediate continuity; sin persistencia, private context or actions.

consented_contact.note: Optional post-audit local preview with separated consent. The public release does not persist contacts, send email or prove domain ownership.

email_operations.note: The public contract documents candidate addresses, consent boundaries and blocked actions. No mailbox, DNS route, provider, message read or send operation is active.

crm_lite.note: The public contract documents a metadata-only planning model. It is not an active CRM and does not store real contacts or execute commercial actions.

open_knowledge_okf.note: Public read-only OKF v0.2 bundle. AI Catalog discovery is a project convention, not a universal OKF endpoint.

mcp.note: Public stateless read-only MCP on a dedicated Cloudflare Worker. No OAuth, private data, persistence or write actions.

publication_capsule.note: Deployed private owner workflow for manual handoff. It prepares exact files and SHA-256 hashes, records human decisions and downloads JSON; it does not write to the target website.

origin_comparison_and_draft_plan.note: Deployed private Block 5B workflow. It reads only allowlisted public resources, renders bounded diffs and prepares a downloadable technical plan. It does not create a GitHub PR, merge, deploy or modify the target website.

a2a.note: No A2A Agent Card or A2A service is advertised by this release.

cli.note: Repo-first public read-only CLI. No credentials, local writes, remote mutations, MCP or A2A execution.

webmcp.note: Experimental public read-only in-page tool, deployed and observed by the external verifier.

markdown_negotiation.note: Explicit text/markdown negotiation deployed with Vary: Accept and externally observed.

ard.note: Draft-compatible manifests deployed and externally observed; ARD remains an evolving proposal.

x402.note: No paid resource or HTTP 402 payment flow is active.

limits: Observed evidence does not prove indexing or recommendation by any model provider.
The AF score is a proprietary transparent methodology, not an official certification.
Planned and research capabilities do not count as deployed evidence.
